_meta.note: Master string source for Talli (web + native). Keys ARE the literal English UI text -- SwiftUI's Text()/Button()/Label() resolve LocalizedStringKey by matching the literal string against a catalog key, so no Swift call-site changes are needed once a key here matches the code's literal exactly. Web uses the same keys via data-i18n. `review:true` marks finance/benefit strings that must be human-authored or DeepL-reviewed, never blind MT. Empty non-en values fall back to en on web and show as missing in the Xcode catalog. Rewritten 2026-08-02 to match the actual 4-tab UI (Home/Reports/Benefits/Messages/Settings) -- prior keys (pwd.*/rdsp.*/cdb.*/account.*) referenced a removed feature set and were dropped. Dynamic/interpolated strings (payment countdown, dates, version numbers) are intentionally left English-only -- see roadmap for stringsdict follow-up.
